# Design Divider

Design Collection divider family: a section break or section heading in 8 distinct styles, from a hairline with a centered title to an eyebrow heading, a glowing gradient rule, an icon medallion, a pill label, an accent underline, a dotted scene break and a side label with a count. Follows the Universal Theme heading and separator pattern and takes every color from the active theme style.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_DESIGN_DIVIDER` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/designDivider` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |

Pick a Style. Title is optional: without it the divider is a pure separator (role separator); with it the divider is a section heading (h3). Eyebrow and Description are shown by Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label. Meta, for example a count, is shown at the end of the row. Colors follow the active Universal Theme style.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | selectList (`lineTitle`, `eyebrowTitle`, `gradientLine`, `iconCenter`, `pillLabel`, `accentUnderline`, `dotted`, `sideLabel`) | yes | `lineTitle` | Divider design. Line Title: hairlines on both sides of the title. Eyebrow Title: small primary eyebrow over a large title and a rule below. Gradient Line: glowing primary gradient rule with an optional caption. Icon Center: icon medallion on the line, title read by screen readers only. Pill Label: title in a rounded chip on the line. Accent Underline: title over a hairline with a short thick primary segment. Dotted: dotted rule with a small caps title or a three-dot ornament. Side Label: icon and title at the start, rule to the end, Meta as a count chip. |
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional section title, rendered as an h3. Leave empty for a plain separator. |
| `eyebrow` | Eyebrow | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional short line above the title, for example Step 2 or Finance. Shown by Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label; needs a Title. |
| `description` | Description | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional sentence below the title. Shown by Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label; needs a Title. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional Font APEX icon class, for example fa-calendar. Icon Center uses it as the medallion; without it a small diamond is shown. |
| `meta` | Meta | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional short text at the end of the row, for example 12 orders. Side Label shows it as a count chip. |
| `align` | Alignment | selectList (`start`, `center`, `end`) |  |  | Where the title sits. Empty uses the style default: centered for Line Title, Gradient Line, Icon Center, Pill Label and Dotted; start for Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label. |
| `spacing` | Spacing | selectList (`compact`, `normal`, `large`) |  | `normal` | Space above and below the divider. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/design-divider/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_design_divider.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
